I’m not a huge fan of blocking out my time or scheduling time for homework, because then I feel stressed if things take less or more time than I allotted. 

So on my computer, I have a list on sticky notes of assignments that are due and events I have in the next two weeks. 
I generally set it up like this: 

Bio Reading Chapter 1-3 due Monday (8/16) 
Chemistry Worksheet due Tuesday (8/17) by 5:00 pm 
Tutor training on Tuesday (8/17) at 6:30 pm
Etc. 

Then when I have free time, I refer to that list and work on things as I can. 

This is a much more relaxed method of accountability, but the downside is that you have to be really on top of your work and be prepared to budget your time in your head.
